evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This should take me like ten to fifteen minutes and then I'd be able to get you an accurate estimate. (time-boxed but no explicit wait for yes, proceeded directly to gathering details)
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Customer's actual concerns (storage complication, three-week gap) were raised organically by the customer but rep did not ask the two-concerns opener.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised storage/gap concern; rep acknowledged but did not probe deeper. No follow-up like 'tell me more about that.'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned. Rep went straight to logistics after addressing storage question.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: You the best way to go about getting the most accurate estimate is if we can do that virtual walkthrough, like jumping on a video call for you to walk us through the house. Customer confirmed availability and rep texted a link. Clean routing to walkthrough confirmed with next steps (date, phone already captured).

top_strength: Jules cleanly identified that a 2,750 sq ft move warranted a virtual walkthrough for accuracy and successfully routed the customer into it without abandoning the pitch.
coaching_note: On every walkthrough call, deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before routing to the video walkthrough — they come in step 3, before probing, and they answer the customer's actual concerns about reliability and safety.
